## Objectives

- Defeat 50 Road monsters ([Slime](../monsters/slime.md), [Bubbling](../monsters/bubbling.md), [Glimmerwing](../monsters/glimmerwing.md), [Crowned Glimmerwing](../monsters/crowned_glimmerwing.md))

## Rewards

- 137 EXP
- 300 mesos
- +15 standing with [Kestrel](../npcs/kestrel_adventurer.md)
- +20 standing with Fairy Forest

The first time you complete it instead: 274 EXP, 450 mesos, +15 standing with [Kestrel](../npcs/kestrel_adventurer.md), +30 standing with Fairy Forest
